limitations: This report identifies candidate public calibration sources only; it does not digitize or ingest calibration data.
Radiation and overpressure data families may come from different experiments, but production credit requires explicit case-alignment metadata.
The fire-consequence blocker remains until calibrated radiation and overpressure agreement reports pass.

missing_artifacts.required_action: select one radiation source and one overpressure source, record URL/DOI, source hashes, and case-alignment booleans
digitize or obtain heat-flux measurements with distance, tolerance, and source basis
digitize or obtain peak overpressure measurements with distance, tolerance, and source basis
run the official fire consequence report against a generated calibration dataset JSON
